cells.gaps: No body named to carry out the National Data Strategy. A separate National Data Governance Strategy was validated in August 2025 and is not adopted (SLE-005); it does not displace the 2023 strategy, which carries no end date.
cells.note: The 2023 National Data Strategy is adopted and still being carried out in August 2026 (SLE-003). No body is named for it, so stage 3 and not 4.
